You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in culinary techniques, cooking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Savory plays a key role in inspiring a love for cooking while driving sales of cookware, cutlery, and kitchen tools through hands-on savory classes and engaging culinary instruction. farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:e320e8f2-0f.title: Interim Corporate Strategy & PMO Manager
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:e320e8f2-0f.description: At LUXCLUSIF, we are dedicated to redefining the luxury paradigm by offering premium pre-owned fashion to a global audience. As a pioneer in the global luxury resale market, we utilize advanced data-driven solutions to facilitate the buying and selling of high-end pre-owned items. With operations spread across the globe and strategic warehouses in key locations, we ensure a seamless supply of luxury goods. Our comprehensive services cover everything from item curation, quality control, operations, logistics to technology integrations and sales, delivering an unmatched resale experience for brands, retailers, and individual customers alike. We are part of the FARFETCH Group. THE TEAM The Luxclusif Corporate Strategy & PMO team is a newly established team that will be responsible for helping to define and deliver Luxclusif’s strategic priorities by leading the annual planning and OKR processes, managing a portfolio of cross-functional, high-impact projects, and providing strategic advice to business areas. THE ROLE Please note: This is a 12m FTC role with the potential to become permanent for the right candidate. In this position you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and delivering strategic projects that will positively shape the future of Luxclusif. The role will be very cross-functional and focussed on prioritising and managing high-impact initiatives, so we are looking for someone with exceptional interpersonal, project management and critical thinking skills. The ideal candidate is someone who excels in both strategic thinking (i.e. shaping the direction of projects and ensuring we prioritise the most impactful initiatives), and project execution (i.e. driving the timely and cost-effective delivery of projects). We are looking for someone who isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo, but who does so in a collaborative and diplomatic way and ensures that all key stakeholders are brought along on the journey. The role will report to Luxclusif´s Head of Corporate Strategy & PMO. WHAT YOU'LL DO Oversee of a portfolio of cross-functional, high-impact projects to ensure they are successfully delivered in line with expectations (the PMO project portfolio) Project manage key strategic, cross-functional projects Develop and iterate project and PMO documents and processes, ensuring they are aligned with best practise Develop business cases to assess the expected impact of potential projects to inform the project prioritisation process Conduct analysis to identify areas of opportunity for improvements and efficiencies Create reports and dashboards to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and the performance of the PMO project portfolio WHO YOU ARE Experienced in portfolio and project management, with a track record of delivering impactful cross-functional projects Strong interpersonal skills, including confidence working with senior stakeholders and mediating project conflicts Highly organised Strong critical thinking skills, with experience of leveraging data and insights to create reports and business cases Confident working autonomously Proficient in English, both written and spoken Flexible and collaborative with a “can-do” attitude REWARDS & BENEFITS Health insurance for the whole family, flexible working environment and well-being support and tools Extra days off, sabbatical program and days for you to give back for the community Flexible benefits program

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams. Opportunity to work on SAP solutions supporting core banking processes. Exposure to CML, CMS, SAP HANA, object-oriented ABAP, automated testing, and TDD practices. Opportunity to contribute to both operational support and strategic development initiatives. Collaborative Agile/Scrum working environment. Opportunity to strengthen expertise in modern, testable SAP development practices. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7bfbd9f8-5316-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Content Marketing Manager based in United States. This is a high-impact content leadership role focused on building demand and strengthening technical storytelling for sophisticated engineering audiences. You will shape and execute a content strategy that turns complex technology concepts into compelling, accessible marketing experiences. The role spans technical blogs, video, web, social media, advertising, and other content formats. You will work closely with product, engineering, marketing, and sales experts while developing a strong understanding of customer needs and competitive dynamics. AI tools will be an important part of the content workflow, with a strong emphasis on maintaining originality, accuracy, and quality. This is an autonomous opportunity within a collaborative, globally distributed environment where your work can have a direct and visible impact. Define and execute a technical content strategy designed to generate demand and engage engineering-focused buyer personas. Research, develop, edit, and manage technical content across blogs, videos, web pages, advertisements, social media, and other relevant channels. Build deep subject-matter expertise across products, customers, competitive positioning, and the broader technology landscape. Develop and maintain a network of external technical contributors to create a consistent pipeline of high-quality, expert-led content. Own content projects end to end, from ideation and research through production, publication, and performance analysis. Use analytics and performance data to identify content gaps, emerging opportunities, and ways to improve engagement and demand generation. Leverage AI and LLM-based tools to improve content workflows, increase production efficiency, and enhance content quality without sacrificing authenticity. Establish and maintain clear quality standards for AI-assisted content, ensuring output is accurate, useful, original, and aligned with marketing objectives. Collaborate closely with subject-matter experts across product, engineering, marketing, and sales to translate technical knowledge into compelling customer-facing stories. Adapt content to different stages of technical buyer journeys and support broader marketing and business objectives. Requirements 5–7 years of experience in B2B technical marketing, content marketing, product marketing, developer relations, product management, or a related discipline. Exceptional writing, editing, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear and engaging marketing content. Demonstrated expertise creating content for technical audiences and supporting technical buyer journeys. Strong understanding of content marketing, SEO, and GEO best practices. Professional or hands-on experience with software engineering, platform engineering, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, or a closely related technical discipline. Advanced understanding of software development, cybersecurity, identity and access management, cloud, and infrastructure concepts. Proven ability to create or oversee content across multiple formats, including web, blogs, video, social media, advertising, and similar channels. Experience using LLMs and AI-powered tools to accelerate content production while maintaining high standards for accuracy and quality. Strong judgment around AI-generated content, with the ability to distinguish valuable, differentiated content from low-quality or generic output. Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to content quality. High level of autonomy, initiative, and comfort navigating ambiguity while maintaining ownership of projects and outcomes.
